invariants.rationale: The method uses profile extensively; it should not be null at the exit point.
The context object is used in method calls within assignInserts; it is expected to be non-null at method exit.
Partition paths are used to iterate over partitions for workload assignments, so should be non-null.
The assignInserts method updates this mapping, which must be initialized.
The code puts entries into bucketInfoMap, which must be initialized prior to assignment.
